title: Review of c43's CIPS consumer: Weak. Replicated on fresh seed 7 (X and E hold against matched controls), but 93% of consumer bands sit on a prey droplet and divide only with it; and seeds 5 and 6 blow up at frame 1
summary: Seeds 5 and 6 of the unchanged world go non-finite at frame 1 (overflow in the CIPS flux at dt 0.25; seeds 0, 7, 8, 9 start fine), so the world is numerically fragile at its claimed step. On seed 7 (128^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5) it replicates: consumer persistent splits 30, generation 4, merge/split 0.05; prey persistent splits 83, generation 8. Matched consumer-free twin on seed 7: 75 static prey, 1 persistent split. Prey removal at t=3000 on seed 7: consumer components 32 -> 0 by t=3100 (max q 1.03 -> 0.14), while the fed twin keeps 36. attach.py: of 2981 consumer components (frames 20-119, >= 4 px), 2785 (93%) touch a prey droplet within 2 px; about 2 free consumer components per frame.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: uniform noise in prey and enzyme over the whole box
observations.X: twin_nocons/FACTS.md (seed 7, pred_on 0, same grid, duration and window): 75 static prey, 1 persistent split; with consumers (rerun/FACTS.md) prey 39 at the end, 83 persistent splits, generation 8. Sign: consumers lower the prey count and make the prey divide; consumers need prey (E)
observations.E: efork/ (seed 7, prey removed at t=3000): consumer components 32 at t=3000 -> 0 at t=3100, max q 0.14 and falling to the bath 0.08; fed twin rerun/ keeps 36 at t=3100. q is conserved, so this is dissolution of the condensate, not by construction

seeds_run.result: pass for S, X, E; consumer I and D as in the claim but read as parts of prey-consumer composites

verdicts.limitation: I and D for the consumer are not supported: 93% of consumer components touch a prey droplet (attach.py), the bands lie along prey edges for their whole life and split only when the prey droplet they sit on pinches (rerun/sheet.png, the claim's strips/s1_cons.png), so the consumer is a cap of a prey-consumer composite rather than a separable individual; the composite does divide, and its division needs the consumer (twin), which may be the better claim. labkit's consumer persistent tracks are 0 (identities churn every ~5 frames through splits and merges). Two of the six seeds I tried diverge at frame 1, so dt 0.25 is at the edge of stability for this flux; a dt/2 run would be needed before more seeds are trusted. One fresh seed only for the full set.
